notes.general_comments: General Comments The mean mark was 17, with many candidates bunching in the middle range. Only a few candidates attained high or low marks. There were no relatively easy questions on the paper. Candidates were required to have some basic knowledge of accounting in order to answer any of the questions. The following questions prompted many correct responses: 1, 5, 8, 13, 17, 20 and 22. It is interesting to note that the management accounting questions do not have as high a correct response rate as the financial accounting questions.
